releaseNotes: FIXED: the export ring never actually animated - it was missing its repaint call, so it looked frozen. It now rotates smoothly at ~60fps while exporting and stops cleanly at 100%
FIXED: reopening AutoEdit during an export now shows the real current progress instead of assuming nothing is running
NEW: pinch-to-zoom and drag-to-pan framing in the Video to Image extractor - extracted frames use exactly the framing you see
Frame extraction already supported Start / End / interval; the new framing works together with it
Export progress percentage now repaints the ring immediately on every real update
Background export, the progress notification, multiple audio tracks and audio muxing are unchanged and still working
